General terms for the United States of America and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Economic Prosperity Deal (web accessible version) HTML Details The general terms document outlines commitments made by the UK and US as part of a new trade deal, and areas where the UK and US intend to negotiate further. The update published on 20 June 2025 provides information on progress the UK and US have made to implement the general terms for the EPD since it was agreed on 8 May 2025. This includes details on: UK implementation of commitments in the general terms relating to beef and ethanol US implementation of commitments in the general terms relating to beef, automobiles (including parts), aerospace and steel and aluminum ongoing negotiations Updates to this page Last updated: 20 June 2025 Show all updates 20 June 2025 'Update on the UK-US Economic Prosperity Deal (EPD)' document added to the page. This document provides information on progress the UK and US have made to implement the general terms for the EPD since it was agreed on 8 May 2025. 9 May 2025 Web accessible version of 'General terms for the United States of America and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Economic Prosperity Deal' document added to page. 8 May 2025 First published.
